details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:123-125 (with scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:133, :864-890; .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:580, :616) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The promote cycle still polls the gate_only gate run for at most 18000 s (`PROMOTE_CYCLE_GATE_WAIT_SECS`) inside a 340-minute job, but this PR raises the e2e-smoke-test job limit to 360 minutes and moves the Phase 4 runner-wait ceiling later.
  WHY: A gate run that waits out a long runner queue, the scenario this PR targets, can now outlast the promote window, so `fail_cycle smoke_gate_timeout` (promote_main_cycle.sh:889-890) fires and counts toward PROMOTE_CYCLE_MAX_ATTEMPTS even if the gate later succeeds. Reviewers disagree on severity: google, minimax, openai and z-ai rate it MAJOR; anthropic rates it NIT because it is not a regression versus base and both files are outside the plan's files_touched.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:842-856 (helper return at :98-99, JOBS_JSON `|| echo ""` at :573) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the jobs fetch for an in_progress, queued run fails, `review_waiting_for_runner` fails closed and returns 1. The elif branch then logs a false `E2E_REVIEW_RUNNER_WAIT ... outcome=started` and clears REVIEW_RUNNER_WAIT_SINCE/REVIEW_RUNNER_WAIT_RUN_ID.
  WHY: The next poll restarts `outcome=waiting since=<new epoch>`, which breaks the one-waiting-then-started/ceiling contract in agents.d/9480-e2e-review-runner-wait.md and makes the ceiling diagnostic at :352-355 understate waited_seconds and "after N minutes". The inactivity and ceiling bounds are unaffected, so this is diagnosability only.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:842-856 (RUN_ID "unknown" at :503-505; runs lookup at :489-494; replacement-run branch at :843-846) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A non-rate-limit empty runs lookup sets RUN_ID="unknown", and a replacement run can also still be queued. In both cases the elif branch clears the wait state without any closing `outcome=started` line, and the old run's wait closure is dropped.
  WHY: This breaks the contractual one-waiting-then-started/ceiling sequence and understates the ceiling error's waited_seconds and "after N minutes" on those paths.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:117-119 (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite cited line 616) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `review_step_timeout` input description still says "the 300-minute smoke-test job timeout kills the run", but this PR raises timeout-minutes and E2E_JOB_TIMEOUT_MINUTES to 360.
  WHY: Operators configuring the dispatch input are told the job dies an hour earlier than it does. The fix is a one-word change.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:83-86 (JOBS_STEP_JSON reassigned at :769) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The comment "JOBS_STEP_JSON (fetched only for runs that are not in_progress) is never read" is inaccurate, because JOBS_STEP_JSON is also fetched on in_progress polls whose JOBS_JSON read failed.
  WHY: There is no runtime defect, but it misleads anyone debugging a future incident.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Phase 4 stops counting time as inactivity while the watched review run is waiting for a runner. The wait stays bounded by the existing deadline ceiling." The change also "moves that ceiling 60 minutes later" via the 300→360 e2e job limit, so the wait can ride out a real runner queue.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml and scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh (gate wait and job timeout that wrap test-and-mark-stable.yml)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Neither file has a diff hunk. promote-main-to-stable.yml:125 still says `timeout-minutes: 340` and promote_main_cycle.sh:133 still defaults `PROMOTE_CYCLE_GATE_WAIT_SECS=18000`. Under a runner queue, the cycle will hit `fail_cycle smoke_gate_timeout` at promote_main_cycle.sh:889-890.
- requirement: The pre-push gate report in the PR description classifies six failures as "caused by this change": the fragment-contract, label-precreation, changelog-fragment, provider-outage and checkout-ref-audit tests, plus `ruff`.
  expected_change_site: The PR's CI gate (`.github/workflows/pre-push-gate*.yml` or equivalent) plus the test files themselves
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No commit fixes the underlying cause or reclassifies the failures. test_agents_fragment_contract.py, test_changelog_fragment_contract.py and test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py read files this diff does not touch. The PR description still says these failures are caused by the change.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:123-125 (with scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:133, :856-861, :889-890; test-and-mark-stable.yml:572, :580, :616) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The promote cycle allows the gate at most 5 h inside a 340-minute job, both sized for a 300-minute e2e job. The PR raises the e2e job to 360 and keeps Phase 4 polling through a runner queue until job start + 275 min, followed by Phase 4b, 6 and 7.
  WHY: A gate_only run that rides out a long queue and succeeds can pass 18000 s after the promote cycle has already hit `fail_cycle smoke_gate_timeout` (which counts toward PROMOTE_CYCLE_MAX_ATTEMPTS). This is not a regression versus base. Both files are outside files_touched, so a follow-up issue may be the right handling.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:98-99, 850-856 (JOBS_JSON at :573; runs lookup at :490-494, RUN_ID="unknown" at :505; replacement-run branch at :843-846) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed jobs read for a queued in_progress run makes the helper return 1, so the elif logs a false outcome=started and clears the wait state. An empty runs lookup, or a replacement run that is also queued, resets the state without a closing line.
  WHY: The E2E_REVIEW_RUNNER_WAIT contract in agents.d/9480-e2e-review-runner-wait.md gets a false started line, and the ceiling diagnostic at :352-355 understates waited time. Limits are unaffected. Suggested fix (about 3 lines): only print started and clear when RUN_ID is numeric and either RUN_STATUS != in_progress or JOBS_JSON is non-empty.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:117-119 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The review_step_timeout description still says "300-minute smoke-test job timeout" after the job limit was raised to 360 (lines 580, 616).
  WHY: Operators are told the job is killed an hour earlier than it is.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. All issue #9480 deliverables were verified present. The six pre-push gate failures come from files the diff does not touch, so they are not TASK_GAPs.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): (1) scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh lines 850-856: guard the clear with `[[ "$RUN_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && { [ "$RUN_STATUS" != "in_progress" ] || [ -n "${JOBS_JSON:-}" ]; }`, about 3 lines. (2) Lines 83-84: the comment "fetched only for runs that are not in_progress" is inaccurate because line 769 also fetches it; reword to "fetched whenever JOBS_JSON is empty", 1 line. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:123-125 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The promote cycle job has timeout-minutes: 340, while the PR raises the e2e-smoke-test limit to 360 and moves the Phase 4 runner-wait ceiling later.
  WHY: A long gate run waiting out a runner queue can exceed the 340-minute limit, so the cycle hits fail_cycle smoke_gate_timeout even if the gate later succeeds.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:842-856 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The elif branch assumes a return of 1 from review_waiting_for_runner means the run left the wait, but the helper also returns 1 when the JOBS_JSON lookup fails.
  WHY: A transient lookup failure logs a false outcome=started and clears the wait state, which truncates the reported wait duration.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:616 (comment/input description) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The review_step_timeout input description still references the old 300-minute job limit.
  WHY: Misleads operators setting step timeouts.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  PROBLEM: The gate_only gate is polled for at most 18000 s inside a 340-minute promote job, below the gate's new 360-minute ceiling.
  WHY: The cycle will fail_cycle smoke_gate_timeout (promote_main_cycle.sh:889-890) and skip the release during exactly the runner queue this PR targets. Neither file is in files_touched.

  PROBLEM: A failed jobs fetch for a queued in_progress run makes the helper return 1 (line 98). The elif then logs a false outcome=started and clears the wait state, and the next poll starts a fresh `since=`.
  WHY: The truncated waited_seconds understates the ::error:: message at :355, which breaks the contracted one-waiting-then-started/ceiling sequence. The bounds still hold.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:842-856 (and :503-505, :489-494) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When RUN_ID becomes "unknown", or a queued successor run replaces the watched run, the wait state is cleared and the outcome=started line is silently skipped.
  WHY: This breaks the contract sequence in agents.d/9480-e2e-review-runner-wait.md and understates the ceiling error's waited time.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:102-122 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Line 119 still says "...the 300-minute smoke-test job timeout kills the run." even though the job limit is now 360.
  WHY: Operators misjudge how long their override can ride.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:78-100 (comment at lines 83-86) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The comment "JOBS_STEP_JSON (fetched only for runs that are not in_progress) is never read" is imprecise, because :769 also reassigns it on in_progress polls whose jobs fetch failed.
  WHY: There is no runtime defect, but it misleads future debugging.
